(1) face recognition systems are challenged by facial occlusion, SSPS, and facial expression, and (2) the most promising techniques to overcome the three challenges are the use of 3D data, the use of multiple samples, the use of a large training set, the use of active learning, and the use of a multi-modal system.

the most effective approaches for dealing with the three challenges are: (1) the use of the Gabor-based face recognition technique for dealing with the occlusion challenge; (2) the use of a fusion technique based on the combination of the Gabor features and the local binary pattern for dealing with the SSPS challenge; and (3) the use of Gabor-based features and a support vector machine for dealing with the facial expression challenge.

(i) the most promising approaches for handling the occlusion problem are based on the fusion of multiple classifiers, the use of 3D information, the use of multiple images, and the combination of 2D and 3D information; (ii) the best solutions to handle the SSPS problem are based on multiple images; and (iii) the best approach to handle the facial expression problem is based on the use of 2D information.
